reuse.why: Adds the guard to the existing link.ts helper module beside findOrCreateBank and calls it through the same link.* namespace every handler already uses.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; each of the five handlers repeats a small call block and its provider literal, which is unavoidable given the per-provider handlers.

placement.why: A linking precondition lives in server/accounts/link.ts, the module this tree uses for shared bank-link logic, and runs before any mutation.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and targeted tests.

maintainability.why: One clearly named assertion with a typed provider parameter; the rule can be changed in one function.

one_place.where: server/accounts/link.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called by all five link handlers in server/accounts/app.ts
